budget_rule: All four cells, five design seeds, four paired sampler seeds, and both methods run to the fixed cap; failures and gate misses remain results. No retrospective retuning.
reference: exact Gaussian posterior; independent draws; fixed exact-covariance whitening
cost_scope: setup-inclusive per four-chain collection; CV cache, full metric construction, inverse, factorization, warmup and retained transitions; excludes common data generation, exact-reference draws, scoring
interpretation_limit: Four quadratic cells test controlled geometry and CV order only; no generic nonquadratic dimension/conditioning trend.
